description:
List the onboarding plans this API key drafted on its workspace (#841): newest change first, at most 50. A person's drafts and other workspaces' plans are not shown. Free.

Needs an API key with the 'onboard' scope (#844), which is never on by default: an organisation admin or engineer ticks it on a new key (a key that had 'workflows' before #844 was given it). Without it the call fails naming the scope: ask a person for such a key rather than retrying.

Returns: { plans: [{ plan_id, status (draft | awaiting_approval | applied | reverted), revision, summary, updated_at, link }] }. The link opens the plan in the portal.
name: handinloop_list_onboarding_plans
title: List Onboarding Plans
